nodes.description: Italian criminal organization of mafia type originating from Calabria. Recognized as a unitary criminal organization with a collegial leadership by the Italian Supreme Court in 2016. It is the only mafia present on all five continents, with an estimated global turnover of 150 billion euros as of 2022. Its main activity is drug trafficking, followed by involvement in public contracts, vote buying, extortion, usury, arms trafficking, gambling, and toxic waste disposal.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Abbruzzese is a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cassano allo Ionio and Corigliano Calabro, in the province of Cosenza, Italy. It emerged in the late 1990s, initially involved in armored car robberies, and is composed of Romani individuals. The group has been involved in a war with other 'ndrine in Cosenza from 1999 to 2001 and has been targeted in several police operations, including Timpone Rosso (2009) and Gentleman (2015).

The Accorinti are a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Briatico, Tropea and Zungri, in the province of Vibo Valentia, Italy. Their existence was legally established in August 2020 following the 'Costa pulita' operation of 2016. They have ties with the Giampà 'ndrina of Lamezia Terme and the Mancuso clan. The clan is involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and other criminal activities.

The 'Ndrina Acri is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta criminal organization based in Rossano, Calabria, Italy, with operations extending to Germany. It is involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and other crimes. The clan was targeted in the 'Timpone Rosso' operation in 2009, and in 2013, 28 members were arrested and assets worth €40 million were seized.

nodes.description: The Agresta are a 'ndrina of the Calabrian 'Ndrangheta, originating from Platì and active since at least the 1920s. They are also active in Piedmont, particularly in Volpiano, where they collaborate with the Marando and Trimboli families. Involved in drug trafficking, extortion, illegal gambling, and money laundering, they have been targeted in operations such as Minotauro and Cerbero.

nodes.description: The Albanese are a powerful 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cittanova and Laureana di Borrello, Calabria. They have branches in Brescia, Tuscany, Lazio, and Liguria. Their activities include drug trafficking, grape market control, and past kidnappings. They are allied with the Raso-Gullace clan and have been involved in feuds with other clans.

nodes.description: The Alvaro 'ndrina is a powerful 'Ndrangheta clan originating from Sinopoli, Calabria, with around 2,000 affiliates. It operates in various Italian provinces and has international branches in Australia. The clan rose to prominence after a 1945 feud and was involved in kidnappings and drug trafficking in the 1970s. It remains active, with recent operations revealing ties to other 'Ndrangheta clans.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Anello is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Filadelfia, Calabria, Italy. Its activities include robberies, extortion, and drug trafficking. The clan has been involved in several operations by Italian authorities, including Operation Imponimento in 2020 which led to 75 arrests. It has interests in wind farm contracts and maintains alliances with other 'ndrine such as the Cracolici and Bonavota.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Araniti is a historical and powerful clan of the 'Ndrangheta in Calabria, operating in Sambatello, Reggio Calabria. According to the 'Sistema Reggio' operation, they are one of five 'ndrine with absolute monopoly over commercial and economic activities in Reggio Calabria. The clan has been involved in criminal activities for over 50 years, including extortion, kidnapping, usury, money laundering, and public contract fraud. Members have been arrested in various operations, and assets worth millions of euros have been seized.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Arena is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta criminal organization based in Isola Capo Rizzuto, Calabria, Italy. It has influence in the Catanzaro area through alliances with local clans. The clan has been involved in drug and arms trafficking, counterfeiting, extortion, and murder, with operations extending to Brazil and Germany. Key figures include Nicola Arena and Carmine Arena.

nodes.description: The Avignone are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Taurianova, Reggio Calabria. They operate in Taurianova and were involved in drug trafficking in Genoa during the 1990s. Allied with the Mamone, Piromalli, Zappia, and Gullace-Raso-Albanese clans. The DIA describes them as one of the most traditional and high-profile criminal organizations in the 'Ndrangheta.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Barbaro is a powerful 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Platì, Calabria, Italy. Founded in the late 19th century, it is one of the oldest still-active 'ndrine. The family has multiple branches and is heavily involved in drug trafficking and arms possession. It has expanded its operations across northern Italy and into Australia, particularly in Melbourne and Griffith.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Barreca is a 'ndrina (criminal family) of the 'Ndrangheta in Calabria, based in the southern area of Reggio Calabria, active since the 1980s. It operates in the neighborhoods of Pellaro, Bocale, and Lazzaro. Originally part of the Ambrogio clan, it split off during the Pellaro feud in the late 1980s. The clan has been involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and violent feuds, and several members have become pentiti (collaborators with justice).

The Belcastro are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Sant'Ilario dello Ionio, Calabria. They were involved in the Sant'Ilario feud against the D'Agostino clan in the 1990s. Key members include Giuseppe Belcastro, a life-sentenced capobastone, and Domenico Belcastro. The group has been targeted by operations such as Primaluce and Dogville.

The 'Ndrina Belfiore is a Calabrian criminal organization based in Gioiosa Jonica, with operations in Turin, France, and Spain. It was involved in the 1983 murder of magistrate Bruno Caccia in Turin. The group has been engaged in drug trafficking, including a 1994 seizure of 5 tons of drugs. Recent operations in 2008 and 2018 targeted the clan.

nodes.description: The Bellocco 'ndrina is a powerful organized crime clan from Rosarno, Calabria, part of the 'Ndrangheta. Active in drug and arms trafficking, extortion, and control of businesses, it operates mainly in Italy and has international connections. The clan played a key role in founding the Sacra Corona Unita in 1981. Its influence extends to Lombardy and other regions, with ties to other 'ndrine such as Pesce and Piromalli.

nodes.description: The Bonavota are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Sant'Onofrio and Stefanaconi, in the province of Vibo Valentia, Calabria. They have members in Piedmont (Turin, Carmagnola, Moncalieri) and Rome, and are allied with the Anello, Lo Bianco, and Mancuso clans. Their activities include extortion, usury, drug trafficking, and money laundering. They were involved in a bloody feud against the Petrolo-Bartolotta clans in the 1980s-1990s.

The 'Ndrina Bruni is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, a Calabrian mafia organization, based in Cosenza, Italy. It is involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and infiltration of businesses. Key members include Michele Bruni, arrested in 2009, and Luca Bruni, who disappeared in 2012. The clan has been targeted in major police operations, including a 2010 arrest of 49 people.

The Bruzzaniti are a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta criminal organization, originating from Africo, Calabria, Italy. They are active in the Milan area and are allied with the Morabito, Palamara, and Crisafulli clans. The article provides a brief overview of their history from the 1970s to the 2020s.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Bruzzise is a 'Ndrangheta clan based in Palmi, Calabria, allied with the Parrello clan. It controlled the 'Montagna delle nevi' area and was involved in a long-running feud with the Gallico-Morgante-Sgrò-Sciglitano clan from 1977 to 1990. In the 2000s, the feud reignited, leading to the 2010 'Cosa mia' operation that arrested 46 members for extortion, mafia association, and infiltration in public contracts.

The Bubbo are a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, a Calabrian mafia, operating in Petronà, Cerva, and Sersale, Italy. They are allied with the Nicoscia, Farao-Marincola, and Trovato clans. Involved in arms trafficking and a feud with the Carpino clan in the 1990s, with violence extending to Lecco. In 2020, members were arrested in Operation Borderland.

The 'Ndrina Carelli is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Corigliano Calabro, Italy. It operates primarily in Germany, involved in drug trafficking in cities such as Bochum, Münster, Frankfurt, Berlin, and Munich. The clan is allied with the Roma of Lauropoli and the Critelli clan of Cariati. It has been targeted in operations such as 'Santa Tecla' in 2010, which led to numerous arrests and asset seizures.

country_links.evidence_quote: Hanno diramazioni soprattutto in Germania e sono attivi nel traffico di droga a Bochum e Münster e sono presenti anche a Francoforte , Berlino e Monaco .
country_links.context: The 'Ndrina Carelli has branches in Germany and is active in drug trafficking in several German cities.

nodes.description: The Carpino are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta operating in the municipalities of Petronà, Cerva, Sersale and the Levante area. They are also active in Liguria, in the province of Genoa, in the municipalities of Chiavari and Lavagna. The group has been involved in a feud in Petronà since the 1990s, with numerous attacks and murders. In 2014, assets worth 2 million euros were seized from an alleged affiliate.

The Carvelli are a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Petilia Policastro in the province of Crotone, Calabria. They have expanded operations to northern Italy, particularly Milan (Quarto Oggiaro) and Turin, with a focus on drug trafficking. The group has been involved in murders and vendettas, and maintains alliances with other local 'ndrine such as the Trovato and Comberiati-Garofalo families. Recent operations have targeted their drug networks in the Milan area.

The Cataldo are a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cetraro, Italy, with strong presence also in Portigliola, Gerace, and Antonimina. They are allied with the Marafioti and historical rivals of the Cordì. Their illicit activities include drug and arms trafficking, and infiltration into public works and contracts. They have been involved in a long-running feud with the Cordì since the 1960s, with violent clashes continuing into the 2000s.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Cicero is a 'ndrina (criminal family) of the 'Ndrangheta, based in Cosenza, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in organized crime activities such as drug trafficking and extortion. Members include Domenico, Osvaldo, and Francesco Cicero. In 2011, assets worth €4 million were seized from the group.

The Codispoti are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Luca, Calabria, Italy. They are allied with the Nirta-Scalzone, Romeo, Libri, and De Stefano families. They have been involved in drug trafficking from South America to Italy and other European countries, and have served as mediators in the Reggio Calabria mafia war. The clan is considered a reference point for the 'Ndrangheta in Rome.

nodes.description: The Comberiati are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Petilia Policastro, Calabria, Italy. They are allied with the Coco-Trovato clan and have controlled neighborhoods in Milan, particularly Quarto Oggiaro. The clan has been involved in multiple murders, including the 2009 killing of witness Lea Garofalo. Key members include boss Vincenzo Comberiati, arrested and sentenced to 41-bis solitary confinement.

The 'Ndrina Condello is a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Reggio Calabria, Villa San Giovanni, and Fiumara, Italy. It is involved in drug and arms trafficking, contract rigging, and extortion rackets. The clan was led by Pasquale Condello until his arrest in 2008, and later by Domenico Condello until his arrest in 2012. It participated in the Second 'Ndrangheta war against the De Stefano clan.

The Cordì are a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Locri, Calabria, Italy. They are historic rivals of the Cataldo clan and have a strong presence in Portigliola, Gerace, and Antonimina. The clan has been involved in drug trafficking and a long-running feud with the Cataldo family, which has caused over 30 deaths since the 1990s. The clan remains active, with members arrested as recently as 2006.

The Costa are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Siderno, Italy. Initially allied with the Commisso clan, they later became rivals, leading to a violent feud in the 1980s and 1990s. The Costa were involved in drug trafficking with channels in Turin, Gorizia, and Modena. The conflict resulted in the deaths of several Costa members, and the clan was largely annihilated with help from Reggio Calabria clans like the Piromalli. Only two brothers, Giuseppe and Tommaso Costa, survived; Giuseppe later became a collaborator of justice.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Costanzo is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in the area of Catanzaro, Italy. It is allied with the Arena clan of Isola di Capo Rizzuto. The clan is led by Girolamo Costanzo, who is currently imprisoned.

The 'Ndrina Cracolici is a Calabrian 'ndrina based in Maierato, Maida, and Filogaso in the Vibo Valentia province, with branches in Novara and Milan. It is involved in mafia association, murder, extortion, drug trafficking, and illegal arms possession. The group has been in conflict with the Bonavota clan for control of Sant'Onofrio, and was targeted in operations Conquista (2017) and Artemis (2024).

The 'Ndrina Crea is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Rizziconi, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in organized crime activities such as drug trafficking and extortion. The clan has been led by various bosses including Teodoro Crea and Giuseppe Crea, and has been targeted in multiple police operations. As of recent reports, the clan remains active.

The Critelli are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cariati, Calabria, active in the province of Cosenza, Emilia-Romagna, and Germany. They are involved in extortion, money laundering, drug trafficking, usury, and murder. They are allied with 'ndrine from the upper Ionian coast. The group has been targeted in several police operations including 'Galassia', 'Reset 2', and 'Rheinbrücke'.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Cua is a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Natile di Careri, Calabria, Italy. It is active in the appropriation of public contracts and international drug trafficking. The group has been involved in large-scale cocaine trafficking from South America to Europe, with operations spanning multiple countries. It has been targeted in major anti-mafia operations such as Minotauro and European 'Ndrangheta connection.

nodes.description: The D'Agostino are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Reggio Calabria, Italy, with branches in Rosarno, Laureana di Borrello, Sant'Ilario dello Ionio, and Canolo. They are historically powerful, acting as a link between Reggio and Locri clans and representing the 'Ndrangheta within Cosa Nostra in the 1970s. They have been involved in international drug trafficking and feuds, such as the Faida di Laureana and Faida di Sant'Ilario. Many members are currently imprisoned, but the organization remains active.

The 'Ndrina De Stefano is a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Reggio Calabria, Italy, historically considered the most influential in the city. Founded by Domenico Tripodo, it later came under the leadership of Paolo De Stefano. The clan was involved in the first and second 'Ndrangheta wars and has expanded its operations to northern Italy and abroad, engaging in drug trafficking and other illegal activities.

The 'Ndrina Di Giovine is a Calabrian 'Ndrangheta clan based in Reggio Calabria, with branches in northern Italy (Milan) and abroad (United States). It engages in drug and arms trafficking. Women, notably Maria Serraino, have played a leading role in the clan's history. The clan was involved in heroin trafficking from Milan in the 1970s and later expanded into hashish and cocaine.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Dragone is a 'ndrina (clan) of the Calabrian 'Ndrangheta, originating from Cutro, Italy. Founded by Antonio Dragone in the 1960s, it engaged in extortion, robbery, and murder. The clan was involved in a long-running feud with the Oliverio family and later with the Grande Aracri clan. It established operations in Emilia-Romagna, particularly in Reggio Emilia, Modena, and Piacenza. The clan's power declined after the killing of Antonio Dragone in 2004 and subsequent police operations.

The Facchineri are a historical 'ndrina based in Cittanova, Calabria, operating since the late 19th century. They engage in extortion, management of commercial activities, and drug trafficking, with branches in Puglia, Umbria, and Lazio. They were involved in heroin trafficking and kidnappings in the past. The group has been involved in multiple feuds, notably with the Raso-Albanese-Gullace clans, and has connections to the Banda della Magliana in Rome.

The 'Ndrina Faillace is a 'ndrina (criminal family) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cassano all'Ionio, Calabria, Italy. It operates in the Sibari Plain and the province of Cosenza, belonging to the Locale of Sibari. The group emerged victorious from a feud with the Abruzzese-Pepe clan of Lauropoli, alongside the Forastefano and Portoraro families. In 2009, assets including land, vehicles, and companies were confiscated from the Faillace family.

The 'Ndrina Farao is a powerful 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cirò and Cirò Marina, Calabria, Italy. It is allied with the Marincola clan and operates in the provinces of Crotone and Cosenza, with branches across central and northern Italy and in Germany. Its main activities include extortion and drug trafficking, and it has ties with Albanian mafia. The clan rose to prominence in the 1970s and has been involved in contract rigging, illegal gambling, and arms trafficking.

nodes.description: The Fazzari are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta originating from Taurianova, Calabria, with operations in Lombardy, Piedmont, Lazio, Liguria, Australia, and France. They are involved in drug trafficking, illegal waste disposal, vote-buying, and kidnappings. The group is closely allied with the Gullace family and in conflict with the Facchineri family. They have been targeted by anti-mafia operations including 'Saggezza'.

nodes.description: The Ferraro are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Oppido Mamertina, Italy. They are allied with the Raccosta family and part of the local 'ndrina of Oppido Mamertina. The clan has been involved in a long-running feud with the Mazzagatti-Polimeni-Bonarrigo clans, resulting in over 30 deaths. In 2016, boss Giuseppe Ferraro was arrested after 18 years as a fugitive.

The 'Ndrina Ferrazzo is a 'ndrina (criminal family) of the 'Ndrangheta, based in Petilia Policastro and Mesoraca, Crotone, Italy. It is involved in arms and drug trafficking, money laundering in tourism and real estate, and has operations in Sardinia, Lombardy, Abruzzo, Molise, Switzerland, and Spain. The group has alliances with other 'ndrine in the Catanzaro area and has been active since at least the 1960s.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Fiarè is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Gregorio d'Ippona, Vibo Valentia, Italy. It was judicially recognized only in 2013. The clan is allied with the Mancuso family and has been involved in drug trafficking, extortion, usury, money laundering, and illegal immigration. Its leader Saverio Razionale moved to Rome in 2005, expanding the clan's criminal network there.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Forastefano is a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta in Calabria, Italy, operating in the Sibaritide area. It is involved in extortion, usury, vote-buying, drug trafficking, fraud, human trafficking, and infiltration of public contracts and local economic sectors. The group emerged from a split with the Abbruzzese clan and was victorious in a late 1990s-2003 feud against the Zingari of Lauropoli, gaining control over criminal activities in the upper Ionian Cosentino.

The 'Ndrina Franco is a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Reggio Calabria, Italy, primarily active in Pellaro and Lazzaro. It is involved in drug and arms trafficking, contract control, and extortion rackets. The group is allied with the Barreca clan. Founded by Giovanni Franco, it has been active since at least the 1990s and remains operational.

The 'Ndrina Fruci is a 'Ndrangheta clan based in the province of Crotone, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in criminal activities such as drug trafficking, extortion, and murder. The clan has been targeted in several police operations, including 'Prima', 'Effetto Domino', and 'Imponimento'. Key members include Giuseppe Fruci and Vincenzo Fruci.

The 'Ndrina Gaglianesi is a 'Ndrangheta clan based in Catanzaro, Italy. It is involved in organized crime activities typical of the 'Ndrangheta. The clan has a structured hierarchy with several capibastone (bosses) overseeing different neighborhoods of Catanzaro. Notable members include Tommaso Mazza, who became a pentito (collaborator) in 1994.

The Galati are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Giovanni di Mileto, operating in the Vibonese area and in Brianza, Lombardy. They have ties with the Mancuso clan. The group has been involved in real estate speculation in Rho, Milan, and several members have been convicted for mafia association and illegal weapons possession.

The 'Ndrina Gallace is a powerful 'Ndrangheta clan originating from Guardavalle, Italy. Over the last 30 years, it has expanded its operations across Italy, including Tuscany, Lazio, Lombardy, and Rome. The clan is heavily involved in international drug trafficking, fraud, usury, and extortion. It is allied with other 'Ndrangheta clans such as Farao-Marincola and Leuzzi.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Gallelli is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Badolato in the province of Catanzaro, Calabria. It is involved in criminal activities such as extortion and fraud, including illicitly obtaining European Union funds. The clan has been targeted by law enforcement operations like Itaca-Freeboat and Pietranera, leading to arrests and convictions. As of 2017, its alleged boss Vincenzo Gallelli was imprisoned.

The Gallico are a 'ndrina (mafia clan) based in Palmi, Italy, active in extortion, drug trafficking, and infiltration of public contracts. They are the strongest family in the municipalities of Palmi, Barritteri, Melicuccà, and Seminara, and also operate in Rome. The clan has been involved in a long-running feud with the Parrello-Condello and Bruzzise clans, which ended in 1990. In 1994, Teresa Concetta Managò became the first female pentito of the 'Ndrangheta in a trial against the Gallico clan.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Gentile is a 'Ndrangheta clan based in Amantea, Calabria, Italy. It engages in extortion, drug trafficking, and usury. The clan has been involved in political corruption, with members arrested for vote-buying. Its assets have been seized in multiple operations, including the 2007 Nepetia operation.

The 'Ndrina Giacobbe is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Borgia, Calabria, Italy. It is allied with the Gaglianesi clan. After the death of boss Antonino Giacobbi, control passed to the Passafaro family, while the Pilò-Cossari remain criminal referents in the coastal area.

The 'Ndrina Giampà is a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in the Nicastro district of Lamezia Terme, Italy. It emerged in the late 1980s under the leadership of Francesco Giampà, known as 'Il professore', who won a violent feud against a rival faction. The organization is involved in drug trafficking (cocaine and marijuana) and arms trafficking. It was a key player in the Lamezia Terme feud from 2002 to 2011, which resulted in numerous murders.

The Giglio are a 'ndrina (criminal clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Strongoli, Calabria, Italy. They are involved in international drug trafficking, usury, arms trafficking, money laundering, and control of the local economy. They have been allied with other 'ndrine such as Grande Aracri and Farao-Marincola. The clan was involved in a feud with the Valente family in the early 2000s and was targeted in the 2018 Operation Stige.

country_links.context: The Giglio clan imposed their wine and pizza products in Germany.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Gioffrè is a powerful 'Ndrangheta clan based in Seminara, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in drug trafficking, arms trafficking, cigarette smuggling, prostitution, illegal waste disposal, infiltration of local government, and money laundering. The clan emerged victorious in the Faida di Seminara in the 1970s and later experienced internal conflicts in the 2000s. It remains active.

The 'Ndrina Giorgi is a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from San Luca, Calabria, Italy. They are involved in international drug trafficking, with operations in Germany, the Netherlands, and Rome. They have alliances with other 'ndrine such as the Nirta, Romeo, and Morabito families. The group has been targeted by multiple police operations in the 2010s and 2020s, including Puerto Liberado and Koleos.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Grande Aracri is a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cutro, Calabria, Italy. It operates extensively in northern Italy (Emilia-Romagna, Veneto, Lombardy) and abroad in Germany. The group is involved in drug trafficking, false invoicing, extortion targeting tourist villages, and construction fraud. It emerged in the 1980s under Nicolino Grande Aracri and has been engaged in feuds with rival families.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Iamonte is a historical 'ndrina of the Calabrian 'Ndrangheta, originating from Melito Porto Salvo, Italy. It is involved in drug trafficking, money laundering, public contracts, and arms and explosives trafficking. The organization has expanded its operations to various Italian regions and Eastern Europe. It has been targeted by multiple police operations since the 1990s.

The 'Ndrina Iannazzo is a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta in Calabria, based in Lamezia Terme. It is allied with the Giampà and Cannizzaro-Daponte clans. The group has been involved in a long-running feud with the Torcasio-Gualtieri-Cerra clan, resulting in dozens of murders. It has also infiltrated public contracts, including the modernization of the A3 motorway, and has been linked to political corruption. In 2022, assets worth €800 million were seized from its associates.

The Ierinò or Jerinò are a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Gioiosa Ionica, Calabria, Italy, involved in drug trafficking. They are also present in Ivrea, Salento, Borghesiana, and Pisticci. They are allied with the Mazzaferro, Cataldo, and Costa clans. The clan was involved in kidnappings in the 1970s and 1990s, including the 1975 kidnapping of Tobia Matarazzi and the 1993 killing of Vincenzo Mazzaferro.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Imerti is a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta from Villa San Giovanni, Calabria. It was a principal 'ndrina that triggered the Second 'Ndrangheta War. The organization is allied with the Condello, Alvaro, and other 'ndrine. Its boss Antonio Imerti was arrested in 1993 and released in 2021.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Iona is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta criminal organization based in Belvedere di Spinello, Calabria, Italy. Its boss is Guirino Iona, who is detained under the 41-bis prison regime. The clan is involved in mafia association, weapons offenses, and multiple homicides.

The Iozzo-Chiefari are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta, composed of two families from Chiaravalle Centrale and Torre di Ruggiero, also active in Cardinale. They are part of the Locale of Serra San Bruno. Involved in drug trafficking, illegal weapons, construction, earthmoving, timber, and subcontracting. Several members have been arrested in operations such as Ortrhus (2019) and Anteo (2021).

nodes.description: A powerful 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Luca, Calabria, Italy. Active since the late 19th century, it is considered one of the most influential 'ndrine of all time. The clan is involved in drug trafficking, particularly heroin and cocaine, and has ties to other 'Ndrangheta families. It has been implicated in historical events such as the kidnapping of Aldo Moro.

nodes.description: The La Rosa are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Tropea, Italy. They are allied with the Mancuso clan of Limbadi and have been in a feud with the rival Piserà clan. Since the 2000s, they have established a presence in Santa Domenica di Ricadi. The group is involved in extortion, drug trafficking, and arms trafficking.

The 'Ndrina Labate is a powerful 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta in Reggio Calabria, Italy. It operates in the neighborhoods of Gebbione, Rione Ferrovieri, Sbarre, and Stadio, and is allied with the Tegano clan. The clan has been targeted in several police operations, including 'Archi' (2011), 'Helianthus' (2020), 'Cassa Continua' (2020), and 'Las Vegas' (2020). Its leader, Pietro Labate, was arrested in 2013 and sentenced to 20 years for extortion and mafia association.

The 'Ndrina Lamalfa is a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Ferdinando, Italy. It was involved in the kidnapping and murder of Michele Arcangelo Tripodi in 1990, whose body was found in 1997. The clan has been active since at least the 1990s and continues to operate.

The 'Ndrina Latella is a powerful 'ndrina (mafia clan) based in Reggio Calabria, Italy, controlling the neighborhoods of Ravagnese, Croce Valanidi, and Pellaro. It operates in collaboration with the De Stefano and Pelle clans. The clan has been involved in extortion, money laundering, and drug trafficking, with several members arrested in major operations such as Reale, Reggio Sud, and Araba Fenice.

The Libri are a powerful 'ndrina (mafia clan) based in Reggio Calabria, Italy, allied with the De Stefano, Condello, and Tegano clans. They control illegal activities in central Reggio Calabria, particularly Cannavò, and are present in several neighborhoods. The clan has been involved in the Second 'Ndrangheta war and has faced multiple arrests and asset seizures. As of the latest information, they remain active.

The Lo Bianco are a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Vibo Valentia, Calabria, Italy. They are allied with the Barba family within the local structure. Their illicit activities include public contracts, extortion, usury, and control of the healthcare sector. The group has been targeted by operations such as Nuova Alba and The Goodfellas.

The Lo Giudice 'ndrina is a clan of the 'Ndrangheta, a Mafia-type criminal organization based in Calabria, Italy. It operates in the Santa Caterina district of Reggio Calabria. During the second 'Ndrangheta war, the clan sided with the Imerti-Condello-Serraino-Rosmini alliance. Key members include Giuseppe Lo Giudice, killed in 1990, and Antonino Lo Giudice, a former pentito who later recanted.

The Lo Presti 'ndrina is a Mafia clan of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Marina di Gioiosa Jonica in Calabria and established in Bardonecchia, Piedmont, in the late 1950s. Initially part of the Mazzaferro family, it became an independent 'ndrina. It is known for infiltration of public administration, leading to the dissolution of the Bardonecchia city council in 1995. The clan has been involved in drug and arms trafficking, extortion, and usury.

The Loielo 'ndrina is a Mafia clan from Ariola, a hamlet of Gerocarne, in the province of Vibo Valentia, Calabria, Italy. It is part of the 'Ndrangheta and has been involved in extortion and drug trafficking. The clan rose to power in the 1970s and dominated the Preserre vibonesi area for over twenty years, engaging in a decade-long feud with the Maiolo family in the 1990s. Its leadership was decimated by arrests and internal conflicts, and by the 2010s it was largely dismantled by law enforcement operations.

The Maesano are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta operating in Isola Capo Rizzuto, Calabria, with origins in Roghudi and Roccaforte del Greco. Historically allied with the Arena clan, they engaged in a long and bloody feud for territorial control starting in the 1980s. Their criminal activities include drug trafficking (notably importing from Peru), arms, counterfeit money, and stolen cars, and they have expanded into tourism. Despite arrests and seizures, they remain one of the most powerful 'ndrine, with influence across Italy and abroad.

nodes.description: The Maio are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Martino di Taurianova, Calabria, Italy. They are involved in drug trafficking, usury, and extortion. In December 2011, 21 arrest warrants were executed during Operation Tutto in famiglia, with seizure of assets.

The Mammoliti are a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Oppido Mamertina and Castellace, Calabria. They are involved in drug trafficking, extortion, agricultural activities, and have practiced kidnapping. They have bases in Germany, particularly in Baden-Württemberg and Bavaria. The Mammoliti-Rugolo are allied with the Piromalli, Varone, and Mazzaferro clans.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Mancuso is a powerful 'Ndrangheta clan based in Limbadi and Nicotera, in the province of Vibo Valentia, Calabria. Considered the most influential clan in the province, it is involved in international cocaine trafficking, extortion, usury, public procurement fraud, and money laundering. The clan has alliances with other 'Ndrangheta families, Colombian cartels, and the FARC, and operates in northern Italy, central Italy, and abroad, notably in Togo. It has been described as the financially most powerful criminal clan in Europe.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Mandalari is a 'ndrina (family) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Guardavalle, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in construction, real estate, international drug trafficking, money laundering, waste management, and public contracts. The group has strong ties to Freemasonry and operates in Italy as well as in New York, Nevada, and Arizona in the United States.

nodes.description: The Mangeruca are a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, a Calabrian mafia-type criminal organization. They operate in Cornaredo, near Milan, Italy, but originate from Cirò Marina, Calabria. Active since the 1970s, they are involved in construction, furniture businesses, and public establishments such as bars and restaurants. Recent legal actions include arrests and charges for extortion and aggravated robbery.

The Mannolo are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta from Cutro and San Leonardo di Cutro, allied with the Trapasso-Zoffreo, Pane-Iazzolino, and Grande Aracri clans. They operate in the Catanzaro area, particularly Cropani and Botricello, engaging in drug trafficking, political influence, and arms use. The clan has been targeted in multiple police operations since the 1990s, with members arrested for mafia association, drug trafficking, extortion, and usury.

The Marando are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta from Platì, Calabria, Italy. They are involved in drug trafficking, particularly cocaine and heroin, operating in northern Italy (Milan, Volpiano, Turin, Liguria) and Rome. The clan has been engaged in feuds with rival groups, notably the Stefanelli family. Key activities include international drug trafficking and kidnappings for ransom.

nodes.description: The Mazzaferro are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Marina di Gioiosa Jonica, Italy. They are active in the homonymous Locale alongside the Aquino family, with whom they have been in conflict since the 1970s. They are involved in drug and arms trafficking, extortion, and have expanded into northern Italy and abroad, including Germany, Belgium, and the United Kingdom.

nodes.description: The Mazzagatti are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Oppido Mamertina, Calabria, Italy. They are allied with the Polimeni and Bonarrigo clans and were involved in a feud with the Ferraro-Raccosta clans from 1992 to 1998 and again from 2011. The clan has been active in the cement business and extortion, with assets seized worth €120 million in 2007.

The 'Ndrina Megna is a criminal organization originating from Crotone, Italy, and operating primarily in Turin. It is a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta, involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and arms trafficking. The group has been engaged in feuds with rival clans, notably the Vrenna and Bonaventura families. Key members include Domenico 'Mico' Megna, a capobastone who was imprisoned for nearly 20 years.

The Molluso are a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Platì, Calabria, with a strong presence in Buccinasco, Lombardy. They have been active in Lombardy since the 1980s and are considered satellite affiliates of the powerful Barbaro-Papalia clans. The historical boss is Giosofatto Molluso. Members have been involved in cocaine trafficking with Turkey and Colombia, and more recently in illegal waste trafficking.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Molè is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in the Gioia Tauro plain, Italy. Originally allied with the Piromalli clan, it controlled drug trafficking in the area from the 1980s-1990s, dealing cannabis and cocaine from Colombian cartels. The clan was heavily targeted in the 1993 operation Tirreno, leading to numerous arrests. In the 2000s, it split from the Piromalli and faced further law enforcement operations.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Morabito is a powerful 'Ndrangheta family from Africo, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in illicit activities in northern Italy and abroad, with branches in South America, Europe, and Africa. Its historical boss was Giuseppe Morabito, known as 'u tiradrittu', who was arrested in 2004. The clan has ties to other criminal organizations, including Mafia Capitale in Rome.

nodes.description: The Musitano 'ndrina is a clan of the 'Ndrangheta criminal organization, originating from Platì, Calabria, Italy. They are involved in drug trafficking, illegal waste disposal, and other criminal activities. The clan has a strong presence in Canada, particularly in Hamilton, Ontario, as well as in northern Italy and Brazil. They have been engaged in feuds with rival families, including the Papalia clan in Canada.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Muto is a criminal organization of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cetraro, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in the tourism sector, the fish market, drug trafficking, and has ties to illegal waste disposal. The group has been active since at least the late 1970s and has been implicated in several murders and criminal operations.

The 'Ndrina Nasone is a 'Ndrangheta clan based in Scilla, Calabria, Italy. Active since at least the 1970s, it has been involved in mafia association, extortion, and other crimes. The clan faced several police operations, including Alba di Scilla 3 in 2013 and Lampetra in 2021, leading to arrests. Its current status is active.

The 'Ndrina Nicoscia is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Isola Capo Rizzuto, Calabria, Italy. It is allied with the Grande Aracri and Russelli clans and operates in several Italian regions, including Emilia-Romagna and Lombardy. The clan has been involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and other criminal activities, and has been targeted by multiple police operations such as Scacco Matto and Isola.

The 'Ndrina Palamara is a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Africo, Calabria, Italy. It is allied with the Bruzzaniti and Morabito clans. The group has been involved in drug trafficking, particularly cocaine from South America via Senegal, and in the rigging of public contracts in the tourism and hydroelectric sectors. Members have been arrested in multiple operations, including 'Naos' in 2008.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Pane is a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta from Belcastro, Calabria, Italy. It operates in several towns including Belcastro, Albi, Taverna, Magisano, and Sersale. The group is involved in international drug trafficking, usury, arms trafficking, and money laundering. It is allied with other 'ndrine such as the Grande Aracri and Mannolo of Cutro.

The Papalia are a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta originating from Platì, Calabria, Italy. They are heavily rooted in northern Italy, especially in the Milanese hinterland, with Buccinasco as their stronghold. Their main activities include drug trafficking (cocaine and heroin), extortion, and construction contract management. They have been involved in feuds and high-profile kidnappings, and many members have been arrested in operations like Nord-Sud and Duomo Connection.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Paparo is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, a Calabrian mafia organization, based in Isola Capo Rizzuto, Italy. It is allied with the Nicoscia, Arena, and Barbaro clans and has a branch in the Milan area. The clan has been involved in mafia association, extortion, arms trafficking, and public works corruption, including the high-speed railway line between Milan and Venice. In 2009, a major operation led to multiple arrests and seizures of assets worth €10 million.

The Parrello 'ndrina is a mafia clan based in Palmi, Reggio Calabria, Italy. It is involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and infiltration of public contracts. The clan has been engaged in feuds with rival 'ndrine such as the Gallico. Recent operations have led to arrests for international drug trafficking and corruption.

nodes.description: The Paviglianiti are a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Lorenzo, Bagaladi, and Condofuri, Calabria, Italy. Historically led by Domenico Paviglianiti, dubbed the 'boss of bosses' by the press in the 1990s. They were allied with the De Stefano clan during the Second 'Ndrangheta war. The clan has been involved in drug trafficking, extortion, corruption, and infiltration of public contracts, with numerous members arrested in recent operations.

The 'Ndrina Pelle, also known as Pelle-Vottari, is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in San Luca, Calabria, Italy. It is one of the most influential 'ndrine, with members serving in advisory and top bodies of the organization, particularly in the Ionian mandate and the province. The clan is active in international cocaine trafficking, contract rigging, extortion, and has been documented influencing regional election campaigns.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Perna is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta criminal organization based in Cosenza, Calabria, Italy. It emerged after the death of boss Luigi Palermo in 1977, leading to a split and a violent feud with the Pino-Sena faction that resulted in dozens of murders. The clan was involved in drug trafficking and other criminal activities, and its members were targeted in multiple police operations. The clan's power was consolidated under boss Franco Perna.

The 'Ndrina Pesce is one of the most powerful 'ndrine of the 'Ndrangheta, based in Rosarno, Calabria. It has an army of affiliates organized in 30 'locali' and numerous 'ndrine, with interests extending from Reggio Calabria to Milan. The clan is involved in all trafficking in the Gioia Tauro area, including drugs, extortion, and control of agricultural markets. It has alliances with other major 'ndrine such as Piromalli, Mancuso, and Molè, and is active internationally with connections in Austria, Greece, Lebanon, Germany, and France.

Active since the 1980s in international drug trafficking, they have members in northern Italy, France, Germany, Peru, and Australia. The clan has been involved in feuds with rival 'ndrine such as the Foriglio and has been targeted in multiple police operations.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Pino is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cosenza, Calabria, Italy. It was historically allied with the Sena family and later merged into the Perna clan after a feud in the 1980s. The clan was led by Franco Pino, who became a pentito in 1995. It engaged in drug trafficking, arms possession, and international criminal activities, including involvement in the construction of Bucharest airport in Romania.

nodes.description: The Piromalli are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Gioia Tauro, Calabria. According to the DIA, they are the largest and most influential organized crime group in Western Europe, with over 400 allied families and thousands of affiliates. They have been active for over a century and are among the founders of the 'Ndrangheta. Their criminal activities include international drug and arms trafficking, agricultural fraud, and infiltration of the business sector.

nodes.description: The Piserà are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Tropea, Italy, and allied with the Mancuso clan. In the 1990s they were in a feud with the La Rosa clan. Members have been involved in criminal activities including murder and drug trafficking, with operations extending to Lombardy.

The 'Ndrina Pititto is a 'Ndrangheta clan based in Mileto, Vibo Valentia, Italy. Their illegal activities include extortion and drug trafficking. They were involved in the Stammer operation, which seized 8 tons of cocaine in 2017. The clan has been active since at least the 1980s.

nodes.description: The Polimeni are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Oppido Mamertina, Italy. They are allied with the Mazzagatti and Bonarrigo clans. From 1992 to 1998 they were involved in a feud with the Ferraro-Raccosta clan, which reignited around 2011. In 2013, the Erinni operation led to arrests and asset seizures, potentially ending the violence.

The Rodà are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta from Condofuri, Calabria, operating along the Ionian coast. They have branches in Liguria, specifically in Lavagna, allied with the Nucera and Casile families. The group has been involved in public works corruption, including influencing contracts for the Strada statale 106 Jonica. Recent operations have targeted their activities in Liguria.

The Romeo 'ndrina, also known as Stacchi, is a 'Ndrangheta clan based in San Luca, Italy. It is allied with the Nirta (La Maggiore) and Pelle clans. The clan has been involved in international drug trafficking, money laundering, and other criminal activities, with operations spanning Italy, the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Colombia, and Brazil. Several members have been arrested in major operations such as Puerto Liberado and European 'ndrangheta connection.

nodes.description: The Rosmini are a powerful 'ndrina (mafia clan) based in Reggio Calabria, Italy, controlling the neighborhoods of Ciccarello, Modena, and San Giorgio. They have strong ties to the De Stefano family and extensive interests in Lombardy. The clan has been involved in the second 'ndrangheta war and is known for controlling public contracts in Reggio Calabria. Key members include Diego Rosmini, who held the rank of 'santa', and Antonio Rosmini, arrested in 2004 after a decade-long fugitive status.

The 'Ndrina Ruga is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Monasterace, Italy, dominant in the Stilaro Valley until the mid-1990s. Its activities include construction contracts, agricultural control, and kidnappings in the 1980s. The clan has been involved in drug trafficking and money laundering in Anzio and Nettuno, and has alliances with other 'ndrine. Many members were arrested in the 1994 Operation Stilaro, but some were later acquitted.

nodes.description: The Santaiti are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Seminara, Calabria, Italy. They emerged as a dominant force in the area after winning a feud against the Pellegrino clan in the 1970s. The clan is also present in Liguria and is considered one of the hegemonic 'ndrine of Seminara alongside the Gioffrè. They remain active, with Carmine Demetrio Santaiti as the alleged current boss.

The 'Ndrina Scumaci is a 'ndrina (criminal clan) of the 'Ndrangheta in Calabria, based in the province of Catanzaro. It is allied with other 'ndrine such as the Grande Aracri, Trapasso-Zoffreo, Mannolo, and Tropea-Talarico. The clan is involved in organized crime activities typical of the 'Ndrangheta.

The 'Ndrina Sergi is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, a Calabrian mafia organization, originating from Platì, Italy. It is involved in drug trafficking, particularly cocaine and heroin, operating in northern Italy (Milan area), Rome, and Australia since at least the 1970s. The clan has been implicated in kidnappings, murders, and political corruption, with several members arrested in major operations like Nord-Sud and Marine.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Serpa is a Mafia organization linked to the 'Ndrangheta, operating in the province of Cosenza and originating from Paola, Italy. Its activities include drug and arms trafficking, illegal waste disposal, public contract rigging, extortion, and usury. Founded by Mario Serpa, the clan has been led by various members including Nella Serpa, who took over after her brother's murder. The organization has been involved in violent feuds with rival clans.

The Serraino are a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Cardeto, Santo Stefano in Aspromonte, and Reggio Calabria, Italy. Originating in the 19th century as part of the 'picciotteria' criminal association, they have monopolized criminal activities in their home areas and expanded across Italy and internationally. Their illicit activities include drug and arms trafficking, with connections in Belgium, Canada, Bolivia, France, United States, Germany, Switzerland, Morocco, Libya, and Syria. They were considered the richest and most powerful family in Milan until the early 2000s.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Sia is a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Soverato, Calabria, Italy, with influence in neighboring towns. It is allied with several other 'ndrine and has been involved in a violent feud from 2008 to 2010 that resulted in about twenty deaths. The organization is involved in drug trafficking and has connections in Rome, Milan, and Turin. Recent operations have targeted its leadership and assets.

The Soriano are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Filandari, Vibo Valentia, Italy. They are primarily involved in drug trafficking and extortion in the municipalities of Filandari and Jonadi. They have strong ties with the Mancuso 'ndrina. The group was heavily impacted by the Genesi trial (2000) and the Rotarico operation (2007).

A powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta from San Luca, Calabria, Italy. Historical rivals of the Pelle 'ndrina, they are known for the San Luca feud and the 2007 Duisburg massacre. Involved in drug trafficking and other criminal activities.

nodes.description: The Talia are a 'ndrina (sub-clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Bova, Reggio Calabria, Italy. They have been involved in public works corruption, particularly regarding the SS 106 highway and Palizzi road variant, controlling concrete supply, hiring, and subcontracting. The group was targeted in the 2012 'bellu lavuru 2' operation by Carabinieri, which led to arrests of affiliates and external collaborators. They are part of a network of clans including Morabito-Palamara-Bruzzaniti and Vadalà.

The 'Ndrina Torcasio is a 'ndrina (clan) of the 'Ndrangheta, a Calabrian mafia organization, based in Lamezia Terme, Italy. It is allied with the Gualtieri, Cerra, and Giorgi-Pizzata clans. The clan has been involved in a long-running feud (the Faida di Lamezia Terme) with the Iannazzo-Giampà clan since 2000, resulting in dozens of murders. In 2015, a peace mediated by Reggio Calabria clans was revealed through Operation Andromeda.

The Trapasso are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta from Cutro and Steccato di Cutro, allied with the Mannolo and Grande Aracri clans. They have branches in Emilia-Romagna, particularly in Parma. Involved in drug trafficking, extortion, and infiltration of public contracts and politics. Active from the 1970s to present.

The 'Ndrina Trimboli is a 'ndrina (organized crime family) of the 'Ndrangheta, originating from Platì, Calabria, Italy. It has been active since the 1960s in Australia and since the 1970s in Volpiano, Turin, where it is allied with the Marando and Agresta families. The group has been involved in international drug trafficking, particularly between Italy and Australia, and has faced numerous arrests and operations against it.

nodes.description: The Tripodi are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Vibo Valentia, Italy, allied with the Mancuso clan. They have branches in Lombardy, Lazio, and Veneto. In 2013, Operation Atlantide (later Lybra) led to arrests for vote-buying and corruption, and in 2014, an investigation targeted boss Nicola Tripodi for alleged no-show employment.

The 'Ndrina Trovato is a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta from Marcedusa, Calabria, Italy. It is involved in drug trafficking and money laundering through construction companies and nightclubs. The clan has established a presence in northern Italy, particularly in Milan, Lecco, Como, and Varese since the early 1980s. It has alliances with other 'ndrine such as the Barbaro, Papalia, and Pelle-Vottari families.

nodes.description: The Ursino are a powerful 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Gioiosa Jonica, Calabria, Italy. They are allied with the Aquino, Cordì, and Belfiore clans and have operations in Turin, Liguria, France, Spain, Canada, and England. The clan was involved in the construction of the Port of Gioia Tauro, the murder of anti-mafia activist Rocco Gatto, and the assassination of magistrate Bruno Caccia. They are still active, with recent operations targeting their drug trafficking networks.

nodes.description: The Vadalà are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Bova Marina, Reggio Calabria, with alleged interests also in Slovakia. They are active in international drug trafficking, have direct contacts with a Colombian cartel, and practice extortion. The group has been involved in public works corruption and was linked to the murder of Slovak journalist Ján Kuciak.

nodes.description: The Valle clan is a 'Ndrangheta group originally from Reggio Calabria, Italy, that relocated to Vigevano and Cisliano in the 1980s. Allied with the Lampada family and linked to the De Stefano clan, they are active in real estate, gambling, and restaurants. The clan faced arrests in the 1990s, and their confiscated property, La Masseria, was assigned to the municipality of Cisliano in 2021 after a prolonged legal and community struggle.

The Vallelunga, also known as the Viperari, are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Serra San Bruno, Calabria, Italy. Active since the 1960s, they are considered the hegemonic clan in the mountainous territory spanning the provinces of Catanzaro, Vibo Valentia, and Reggio Calabria. They have been involved in numerous feuds for territorial control, including the Faida dei boschi in the late 1980s, and are regarded as one of the most powerful and bloodiest clans in Calabria.

The Varacalli are a 'ndrina (organized crime clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Ciminà, Calabria, Italy. They operate in the Locride area and also in Turin, where they are involved in drug trafficking. The clan was involved in the Ciminà feud from 1966, which caused about 50 deaths and extended to Turin. Some members have become pentiti (collaborators with justice).

The Violi are a 'ndrina (mafia clan) from Sinopoli in the Gioia Tauro plain, Calabria, Italy. They are allied with the Alvaro clan. Members have been involved in international drug trafficking and other crimes, with operations extending to Canada and northern Italy. Recent arrests include the 2020 Freeland operation targeting multiple clans.

nodes.description: The 'Ndrina Vrenna is a mafia clan ('ndrina) based in Crotone, Italy, founded by Luigi Vrenna. It was involved in a violent feud in the 1970s and later engaged in drug trafficking, extortion, and arms offenses. The clan declined after arrests in the 1970s and faced further crackdowns in the 2000s.

nodes.description: The Zagari are a 'ndrina (mafia clan) of the 'Ndrangheta based in Taurianova, Italy, with operations in Northern Italy and Rome. They are allied with the Viola clan. In the late 1980s and early 1990s, they were involved in a violent feud with the Asciutto-Neri-Grimaldi clans, resulting in 32 murders. The clan's activities include extortion, illegal guardianship, and political infiltration.

country_links.evidence_quote: avrebbe gestito il traffico di droga in Spagna e nel Nord Italia
country_links.context: The organization managed drug trafficking in Spain.

nodes.description: The Zindato-Caracciolo are a 'ndrina of the 'Ndrangheta based in Reggio Calabria, Italy, linked to the more powerful Libri clan. Key figures include Francesco Zindato and Antonino Caracciolo. The group has been involved in extortion and mafia association, with several operations leading to arrests in 2010, 2014, and 2020.

nodes.description: The 10th & Oregon Crew is a predominantly Italian American organized crime gang operating in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and South Jersey. Founded in the 1960s by Rocco Turra, the gang is active in drug trafficking, gambling, extortion, and loan sharking. It has both allied with and feuded against the Philadelphia crime family. The gang remains active as of the present.

A street gang based in Buffalo, New York, formed in the 1980s in the Lower West Side. The gang is multicultural with a Hispanic majority and operates without a traditional leader. It gained notoriety for a violent rivalry with the 7th Street Gang, resulting in 38 homicides between 2009 and 2012. In 2011, 27 members were arrested on RICO charges.

The 110ers are a violent criminal organization based in New Orleans, Louisiana, operating primarily in the 10th and 11th Wards. Founded in the 2000s, the gang is involved in drug trafficking, murder, theft, and kidnapping. They have been under federal investigation since 2010 and were indicted in 2013 for multiple killings, including the death of a child. The gang has feuded with rival groups such as the Young Melph Mafia and Ride or Die Gang.

The 116th Street Crew is a faction of the Genovese crime family based in East Harlem, Manhattan. Founded in the 1890s by the Morello crime family, it was originally known as the 116th Street Mob. The crew engaged in racketeering, murder, extortion, illegal gambling, loansharking, and bookmaking. It absorbed former members of the East Harlem Purple Gang in the late 1970s and early 1980s.

nodes.description: The 14K is a triad group based in Hong Kong but active internationally. It is the second largest triad group in the world with around 20,000 members split into thirty subgroups. Formed in 1945 by Kuomintang Lieutenant-General Kot Siu-wong in Guangzhou, China, as an anti-Communist action group, it relocated to Hong Kong in 1949. The group is heavily involved in drug trafficking, illegal gambling, money laundering, and other criminal activities.

nodes.description: Colombian urban guerrilla group active from 1974 to 1990, founded after alleged electoral fraud. It advocated revolutionary nationalism and democratic socialism, and was the second largest guerrilla group in Colombia after FARC. The group demobilized in 1990 and transitioned into a political party, the M-19 Democratic Alliance. Many of its leaders were later assassinated, but former member Gustavo Petro became President of Colombia in 2022.

The 19th Street Gang was a New York City predominantly Irish street gang during the 1870s, known for anti-Protestant violence. Led by Little Mike, the gang consisted of young pickpockets, muggers, and sneak thieves operating around 19th to 34th Street. They targeted defenseless victims but sometimes spared local Catholics. The gang disappeared by the end of the 1880s.

American white supremacist prison gang formed in 1995 at Denver County Jail by Benjamin Davis. Active both in and out of prison, it is involved in murder, weapons and drug trafficking, kidnapping, and robbery. The gang has been linked to high-profile murders including that of Colorado Department of Corrections head Tom Clements. Its membership is estimated at 1,000.

nodes.description: A street gang based in East Buffalo, New York, founded in the early 2000s and named after the ID number of the Harriet Ross Tubman School. The gang operates in the Willert Park and Broadway-Fillmore areas, primarily involved in drug trafficking, including cocaine and crack cocaine. Members have faced federal charges, and the gang has been active in conflicts with law enforcement.

The 311 Boyz was a teen gang in Las Vegas, Nevada, estimated at 140 members, active in 2003. The group consisted mostly of young males who attended Centennial High School and lived in the northwest area of Las Vegas. They were involved in violent acts, including an attack on a pickup truck that led to multiple criminal charges. Founded by Attila Murat Aydın, the gang engaged in drug trafficking, robbery, extortion, arson, burglary, and vandalism. They marked their territory with graffiti and fought turf battles with Nazi and skinhead groups. After dissolution, some former members became social workers or pursued lawful careers.

Founded in the 1920s, it is one of the oldest street gangs in Los Angeles and is controlled by the Mexican Mafia. The gang engages in drug trafficking, assault, robbery, extortion, and other criminal activities. It gained notoriety during the 1942 Sleepy Lagoon murder trial and the subsequent Zoot Suit Riots.

Ten members were indicted and convicted in 2017.

The 400 Mawozo is the largest gang in Haiti, based in Ganthier and the Port-au-Prince suburbs of Tabarre and Pétion-Ville. Founded around 2020, it consists largely of deportees, former smugglers, and police officers. The gang is known for kidnappings, murder, and rape, and gained international attention in 2021 for kidnapping U.S. missionaries. Its leader is Wilson Joseph, also known as Lanmò Sanjou.

nodes.description: A band of smugglers active in the Romney Marshes and shores of Kent, England, founded around 1817. They used The Walnut Tree Inn as their headquarters and were known for large-scale smuggling operations involving spirits, tobacco, and salt. The gang was likely the last major smuggling gang in Kent and was known as 'The Blues' from the color of their clothing or signal flares.

The Alfieri clan was a Neapolitan Camorra clan operating in the north-east of Naples, with its sphere of influence in Saviano and Nola. Founded by Carmine Alfieri after his father's murder in 1952, the clan became a founding member of the Nuova Famiglia alliance to counter the Nuova Camorra Organizzata. It expanded its power in the 1980s but declined after Carmine Alfieri became a pentito in 1993. The clan is now defunct.

nodes.description: American street gang founded in Chicago in the late 1950s by Eugene Hairston and Jeff Fort. Originally the Blackstone Rangers, it later adopted an Islamic faction called El Rukn. The gang is involved in drug trafficking, extortion, money laundering, murder, and robbery, and is part of the People Nation alliance. It is considered Chicago's most powerful street gang and has been linked to terrorism conspiracies with Libya.

The Almighty Gaylords Nation is a European American street gang founded in Chicago in 1952. It is part of the People Nation alliance and is known for controlling territory in Chicago's West Town, Noble Square, and Kilbourn Park areas. The gang has been involved in extortion, assault, gun trafficking, and murder, and at its peak in 1979 had around 1,500 members. It remains active with an estimated 1,000–2,000 members across multiple states.

The Almighty Insane Popes Nation is a European American street gang based in Chicago, Illinois, formed in the late 1950s. Originally a Greek greaser gang, it adopted the name Popes, standing for 'Protecting Our People Eliminating Spics' (later changed to 'scum'). The gang expanded to include Polish, German, Irish, and Scandinavian members, and later invited Latino and black members. It split into North Side and South Side factions with different alliances.

nodes.description: The Almighty Vice Lord Nation is the second-largest street and prison gang in Chicago, Illinois, founded in 1957 by African American youths in the North Lawndale neighborhood. It is a founding member of the People Nation alliance and engages in drug sales, robbery, extortion, and murder. The gang attempted to soften its image in the 1960s as the Conservative Vice Lords but continued criminal activities. It remains active with an estimated 30,000–35,000 members.

The Amato-Pagano clan, also known as the Scissionisti di Secondigliano, is a Camorra clan from the Secondigliano district of Naples, founded in 2004 by Raffaele Amato and Cesare Pagano. It split from the Di Lauro clan and engaged in a violent feud known as the Scampia feud, resulting in over 100 murders. The clan is heavily involved in international drug trafficking, particularly cocaine, with a strong presence in Spain. Currently, it is one of the most important Camorra organizations.

nodes.description: The Amber Mafia is a criminal network in north-west Ukraine involved in illegal amber mining on government land and smuggling it for sale on the black market. It operates with the aid of armed gangs and corrupt politicians. The network is estimated to involve around 10,000 people and its illegal production could cover Ukraine's military expenditures. It has been the subject of government investigations and protests.

nodes.description: White supremacist organization founded in San Francisco, California by Bob Heick in 1984. Originally modeled after the British National Front, it later transformed into a political organization with skinhead and non-skinhead members. The group held White Workers Day marches and published the tabloid Aryan Warrior. By 1989, it had units in 14 American states.

The American Mafia is a highly organized Italian-American criminal society that emerged in the late 19th century in impoverished Italian immigrant neighborhoods in New York, Chicago, New Orleans, and other US cities. It is structured into families and engages in racketeering, gambling, loansharking, extortion, drug trafficking, and murder. The organization cooperates with Italian organized crime groups such as the Sicilian Mafia, Camorra, and 'Ndrangheta. It remains active today with over 3,000 members and associates.

nodes.description: The Aryan Brotherhood of Texas is a white supremacist prison gang operating in Texas state prisons. Founded in the early 1980s by Texas inmates after being denied affiliation with the original Aryan Brotherhood, it emerged as one of the largest and most violent prison gangs in the United States. The group is responsible for numerous murders, drug trafficking, extortion, and other violent crimes. It remains active with an estimated 3,500 members.

It adheres to Christian Identity doctrine, a white supremacist interpretation of Christianity. The group was classified as a terrorist threat by the FBI in 2001 and described as the first nationwide terrorist network in the US and Canada. After Butler's death in 2004, the organization fragmented into several splinter groups.

It originated as a protective group against rival gangs and later expanded into criminal activities including drug and weapons trafficking. The gang spread to the United States and remains active, with alliances including Nuestra Familia.

nodes.description: Street gang based in Buffalo, New York, founded around 2011 and named after Bailey Avenue. Known for murder, robbery, drug trafficking, and racketeering. The gang gained notoriety after a 2012 shooting in Martin Luther King Jr. Park. Its leader Kenneth Pettway Jr. was arrested in 2018 on federal drug and RICO charges.

Nigerian youth vigilante group that operated mainly in southeastern and south-southern Nigeria from 1998 to 2006. They targeted armed robbers, ritual killers, and kidnappers, often using machetes and guns, and were accused of extrajudicial killings. They claimed magical immunity to bullets, known as Odeshi. The group later rebranded as Anambra Vigilante Services.

nodes.description: The Baltimore Crew was an Italian-American organized crime group based in Baltimore, Maryland, active from the 1920s to the 1990s. Originally independent, it became a faction of the Gambino crime family in 1955. The group was involved in gambling, extortion, loan sharking, drug trafficking, and murder. It was led by the Corbi family for much of its existence.

nodes.description: Italian criminal group active in the 1970s in robberies, kidnappings, and weapons trafficking in the Comasina area of northern Milan. The Banda della Magliana was a mafia-type criminal organization based in Rome, Italy, active from the late 1970s until 1999. It unified the fragmented local underworld under a single structure, engaging in kidnappings, gambling, drug trafficking, and robberies. The group had connections with other Italian criminal organizations, Masonic lodges, far-right terrorists, and intelligence services. It was involved in several high-profile Italian historical events, including the Moro case and the disappearance of Emanuela Orlandi.

nodes.description: The Barbaro 'ndrina is a powerful clan of the 'Ndrangheta based in Platì, Calabria, Italy, founded in the late 19th century by Francesco Barbaro. It is one of the most powerful 'Ndrangheta clans, involved in drug trafficking, money laundering, arms trafficking, racketeering, corruption, extortion, and kidnapping. The clan operates in northern Italy (Lombardy, Piedmont) and Australia (New South Wales). It has been divided into multiple branches and was involved in a feud with the Mammoliti clan.

country_links.evidence_quote: The clan also operates in ... overseas in Australia, in particular in the Griffith, New South Wales area.
country_links.context: The Barbaro 'ndrina operates in Australia, particularly in Griffith, New South Wales, with members involved in cannabis cultivation and drug trafficking.

country_links.context: The Barbaro 'ndrina sources cocaine from Colombia for trafficking to Italy.

nodes.description: The Barreca 'ndrina is a clan of the 'Ndrangheta based in the Pellaro neighborhood of Reggio Calabria, Italy. It emerged as an offshoot of the Ambrogio 'ndrina in the 1980s and became dominant after the death of Carmelo Ambrogio. The clan is involved in drug trafficking, money laundering, arms trafficking, extortion, and murder. Its historic capobastone, Filippo Barreca, became a collaborator with justice in 1992.

nodes.description: Barrio Azteca is a Mexican-American criminal organization originating in El Paso, Texas, founded in 1986 as a prison gang. It has grown into a multinational criminal enterprise with thousands of members in the US and Mexico, primarily involved in drug trafficking, murder, and other organized crime. The group is allied with the Juárez Cartel and La Línea, and is known for its violent cross-border operations.

nodes.description: The Barrow Gang was an American criminal group active from 1932 to 1934, led by Clyde Barrow and including Bonnie Parker. They robbed banks, stores, and gas stations across the Central United States during the Great Depression, killing at least nine police officers. The gang gained national notoriety during the 'public enemy era'.

Italian criminal organization founded in 1994 in Potenza, Basilicata, aiming to become the fifth mafia in southern Italy after Cosa Nostra, Camorra, 'Ndrangheta, and Sacra Corona Unita. nodes.description: The Bottoms Gang was an American street gang based in St. Louis, Missouri, active from around 1905 to 1917. Founded by Frank Hussey and Anthony Foley, the gang engaged in voter intimidation, armed robbery, assault, illegal lottery, and murder. Its members were primarily Irish-American, and the gang was known for extreme violence and feuding with the larger Egan's Rats gang and the St. Louis Police Department. The gang ceased to exist by the time the United States entered World War I.

The Bounty Hunter Watts Bloods is a set of the Bloods gang alliance based in the Nickerson Gardens public housing projects in Watts, Los Angeles. Founded in 1969 by Gary Barker and Bobby Jack, it is known for its violent rivalry with the Grape Street Watts Crips. The gang has over 2,000 documented members and is involved in drug trafficking, robbery, and murder. A 2004 injunction limited members' movements.

The Bowe Brothers were a criminal family in New York City during the early-to-mid-19th century, headed by Martin Bowe. The gang operated along the New York waterfront, engaging in theft, robbery, and fencing stolen goods. They were known as shooters, cutters, and thieves in the Fourth Ward, leading raids on dockyards and ships. The gang was active from around 1840 to 1860.

The Bowery Boys were a nativist, anti-Catholic, and anti-Irish criminal gang based in the Bowery neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City, active from the 1830s to the 1860s. Founded by Mike Walsh and William Poole, the gang consisted of volunteer firemen and engaged in street fighting, knife fighting, assault, murder, robbery, arson, and rioting. They feuded with rival gangs such as the Dead Rabbits and were known for their distinctive uniform of a stovepipe hat, red shirt, and dark trousers tucked into boots.

The Boyd Gang was a Canadian criminal gang based in Toronto, Ontario, active in the late 1940s and early 1950s. Named after member Edwin Alonzo Boyd, the gang committed a series of bank robberies and jail breaks, gaining notoriety in the media. The gang was involved in the fatal shooting of a police detective in 1952. All members were eventually captured and the gang dissolved.

The Bra Boys are a surf-culture gang founded and based in Maroubra, Sydney, Australia, in the 1990s. They are known for territorial violence, alleged links to organized crime, and community activism. The gang gained international attention with a 2007 documentary narrated by Russell Crowe. Members include the Abberton brothers and several professional athletes.

nodes.description: Brazilian militias are illegal paramilitary groups primarily in Rio de Janeiro, composed of current and former police officers, firefighters, criminals, and politicians. They operate as mafia-like organizations, engaging in extortion, protection rackets, and other organized crime activities. Emerging in the late 2000s from death squads of the military dictatorship, they have deep political connections and are involved in high-profile assassinations. The group remains active in the Brazilian drug war.

The Breed Motorcycle Club was a one-percenter motorcycle club founded in Asbury Park, New Jersey in 1965 by Salvatore DeIulio. It engaged in drug trafficking, extortion, and other criminal activities, and was involved in conflicts with the Hells Angels and Pagans. The club disbanded in 2006 after prominent members were indicted on racketeering and drug trafficking charges.

nodes.description: The Medellín Cartel was a loose coalition of Colombian drug trafficking organizations based in Medellín, Colombia, that played a central role in the international cocaine trade during the late 1970s and 1980s. It was founded by Pablo Escobar, Carlos Lehder, Gonzalo Rodríguez Gacha, and the Ochoa brothers. The network was known for its violence, including terrorism and assassinations, and was designated a terrorist group by the United States. It was dismantled in the early 1990s following the death of Escobar.

nodes.description: The Cataldo 'ndrina is a clan of the 'Ndrangheta based in Locri, Calabria, Italy, founded in the 1960s. It has been involved in a long blood feud with the Cordì 'ndrina since the late 1960s, with periods of truce and resumed hostilities. The clan is engaged in drug trafficking, including cocaine from Colombia, and has been allied with other 'Ndrangheta clans. It remains active as of the 2010s.

nodes.description: The Catania Mafia family is a crime family of the Sicilian Cosa Nostra that dominates organized crime in Catania and its province. Founded around 1925 by Antonino Saitta, it evolved into a powerful and violent faction under leaders like Giuseppe Calderone and Benedetto Santapaola. The organization is involved in extortion, drug trafficking, and infiltration of legitimate businesses, and remains active today under the Santapaola-Ercolano clan.

country_links.evidence_quote: Investigations by Italian anti-mafia authorities... revealed that the Santapaola Mafia family has played a central role in transnational criminal activities, with Malta emerging as a strategic hub for its illicit operations.

nodes.description: American street gang based in Buffalo, New York, founded in 2009 in the Towne Gardens Housing Complex. Engages in drug trafficking (heroin, fentanyl, cocaine, crack, marijuana) and weapons racketeering. Involved in turf wars with rival gangs, including the Ronnie Gang. Members have been convicted under RICO statutes.

The Cedar Block Piru is a set of the Piru gang alliance, part of the larger Bloods gang alliance, formed around 1980 in the west side of Compton, California. It gained notability for its connection to rapper The Game, who has referenced the gang in his songs. The gang was involved in the 1992 murder of Allen King and his three children. Its territory includes multiple cities across the United States.

The Cesarano clan is a Camorra clan based in Castellammare di Stabia, Italy, founded in the 1980s by Ferdinando Cesarano. It operates in the Ponte Persica region and Pompei, engaging in extortion, racketeering, usury, and drug trafficking. The clan has been led by Nicola Esposito and currently by Luigi Di Martino. Ferdinando Cesarano was sentenced to life imprisonment in 2000.

The Chaldean mafia is a collective of criminal organizations composed of Chaldeans that emerged in the United States during the 1980s. It is active primarily in Detroit, as well as San Diego and Phoenix. The groups are involved in murder, arson, weapons trafficking, narcotics trafficking, money laundering, fraud, theft, counterfeiting, racketeering, alien smuggling, assault, kidnapping, and armed robbery. The organization was founded by Louis Akrawi, known as the 'Godfather of the Chaldean Mafia', who fled Iraq in 1968.
